name: 子目標との接続状態・期間内の達成予測・自動更新の進捗欄
prompt: Recreate only the Asana goal-progress section in the primary crop, matching its 1168 × 578 px, roughly 2.02:1 landscape geometry. Do not include the page header, completion/status cards above, or the lower Asana intelligence panel. At the top, show bold 「進捗」 at the left with the small source yellow lightning bolt, then a muted warning triangle and 「子目標が接続されていません」. At the far right, show the original small sliders icon and 「進捗の設定」. Below, draw the exact static forecast chart: a small 「今日」 above the January current-date line; y-axis labels 100%, 75%, 50%, 25%, 0% with fine neutral horizontal gridlines; x-axis labels 「1月」 with 「2026年」 below it, then 「2月」「3月」「4月」「5月」「6月」「7月」. Preserve the pale-gray triangular forecast fill rising from the 0% baseline at January to 100% in July, the source blue vertical current-date line at January, and the small gray 0% baseline point. Do not add an actual progress line, extra data or dates. Under the chart, place the source explanatory sentence 「子目標を使って、この目標の進捗を自動で更新します。」. Below it, left-align one filled blue rounded button with a white plus and 「子目標を接続」. Match the original plot area proportions, axis positions, icon colors, spacing, and neutral grid. Use compact regular Meiryo-style Japanese UI type. The original crop controls geometry, chart, values, colors and icons; the Japanese mock supplies localized copy only. Do not use its green button. This raster does not establish chart runtime or editability.
reviewNotes: Progress header, warning and settings control, full 0-100% axis, Jan-Jul 2026 forecast triangle, blue current-date marker, helper copy and blue connect-sub-goal action are present. Candidate 1782x883 (2.02:1) closely matches the 1168x578 source region (2.02:1). Typography and fine strokes are approximations; native editing and live chart behavior are unverified. Agent-reviewed raster candidate only.
